d: Chestnut brown hair is cut into a short, choppy bob with long bangs covering the forehead. Golden-amber eyes have a neutral, solemn expression on a youthful face with a child-like maturity and a petite build. The outfit consists of a white sailor-collared shirt with navy blue trim and a red necktie, paired with a short navy blue pleated skirt, dark grey knee-high socks, and brown loafers. Signature details include a dark hair ribbon and a large, grey mechanical naval artillery assembly mounted behind the back and extending across the front.
